title: Private Sailing Charters in Halifax Harbour
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore Halifax Harbour like never before with a private sailing charter designed just for you. Whether you're looking to relax, celebrate a special occasion, or explore the coastline, each tour caters to your group's preferences. Enjoy visits to Fisherman's Cove, witness breathtaking coastal scenery, and keep an eye out for local wildlife during your sail. With options for various durations and itineraries, this experience offers a unique blend of leisure and adventure. Don’t miss out on creating unforgettable memories on the water in Halifax.

- Private yacht exclusively for your group, accommodating up to 10 guests
- Flexible routes and customizable itineraries for all occasions
- Duration ranges from 2 to 5 hours, tailored to your preferences
- Ideal for families, friends, visitors, and special events like proposals or birthdays
